identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Study of SHR-A1921 or SHR-A2009 in Previously Treated Advanced NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of the Efficacy and Safety of SHR-A1921 or SHR-A2009 in Patients With Previously Treated Advanced NSCLC

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is an open-label Phase II clinical trial to evaluate the safety and efficacy of SHR-A1921 or SHR-A2009 in patients with advanced NSCLC who progressed after standard therapy.

interventions.name: SHR-A2009
interventions.description: Treatment group: Subjects will receive an intravenous infusion of SHR-A2009 until confirmed progression, unaccepted toxicity, or any criterion for withdrawal from the study.

interventions.name: SHR-A1921
interventions.description: Treatment group: Subjects will receive an intravenous infusion of SHR-A1921 until confirmed progression, unaccepted toxicity, or any criterion for withdrawal from the study.
